declarations.name: Diff
declarations.summary: Pierre Diffs viewer with file comparison, patches, line selection, and annotations.

attributes.name: old_file
attributes.description: Original {name, contents, lang?} file. Null represents an added file.

attributes.name: new_file
attributes.description: Updated {name, contents, lang?} file. Null represents a deleted file.

attributes.name: patch
attributes.description: Unified patch text. When non-null, takes precedence over old_file and new_file.

attributes.name: patch_file
attributes.description: Zero-based file index across all commits in a patch. Defaults to 0.

attributes.name: selected_lines
attributes.description: Selection {start, end, side?, endSide?}, using one-based lines and additions/deletions sides; null clears. Programmatic writes do not emit selection-change.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Plain-text annotations [{side, line, text}], using one-based lines or 0 for a file-level note.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Shiki theme name or {light, dark} theme names. Defaults to Pierre's themes.

attributes.name: line_numbers
attributes.description: Show line numbers; true by default.

attributes.name: header
attributes.description: Show the filename header; true by default.

attributes.name: line_diff
attributes.description: Inline highlighting granularity; word-alt by default.

attributes.name: expand_unchanged
attributes.description: Expand unchanged context when full file contents are available; false by default.

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.description: Collapse code beneath the filename header; false by default.

attributes.name: selectable
attributes.description: Enable line selection by click and drag; true by default.
